newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500s rally late, end above key 800.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500s rally late, end above key 800.

text.p: March 24 - U.S. June S&P 500 futures rallied late to end above 800.00 resistance. Traders said intraday short position holders covered their positions late as T-bonds firmed. Some said market has factored in 25-bps rate hike Tuesday and is now looking for a relief rally. Traders said 802.20 and 802.60 resistance for early Tuesday.
